title: Just Say No: Analyzing the Stance of Neural Dialogue Generation in Offensive Contexts
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, TOXICHAT, measures the generation of offensive language and stance alignment in dialogue contexts, including toxicity directed specifically at religious groups.
findings: Both human users on Reddit and neural dialogue models generate offensive content targeting religious groups. The paper's analysis shows that 'religious folks' are one of the top 10 most targeted groups in human responses. Dialogue models like DGPT and GPT-3 also produce offensive comments aimed at 'christian folks', 'jewish folks', and 'muslim folks'.
